increments.baseline: Show weekly intake volume on a single dashboard page.
increments.revised: Show weekly intake volume, filterable by region, with region held between sessions.
increments.reaction: The total is right, but I run three regions and I can only see one number. I still open the spreadsheet to split it.

increments.baseline: Refresh the underlying data set once nightly.
increments.revised: Refresh nightly and stamp each figure with the cutoff time it reflects.
increments.reaction: Nightly is fine. What I cannot tell is whether Monday's number includes Friday's late entries, so I do not quote it in the stand up.

increments.baseline: Restrict dashboard access by user role.
increments.revised: Restrict by case type, since the sensitivity lives in the record, not the job title.
increments.reaction: Roles do not map to what has to stay private. Two people with the same role need different halves of this.

increments.baseline: Let users export the current view to CSV.
increments.revised: Send the Monday summary to the ops lead automatically, no export step.
increments.reaction: I do not want a file. I want the number to arrive where the conversation already happens.

increments.baseline: Chart the last twelve months of intake volume.
increments.revised: Chart each month against the same month last year, since the work is seasonal.
increments.reaction: A rolling twelve months tells me nothing. August is always slow. I need August against last August.

increments.baseline: Make the dashboard usable on a phone screen.
increments.revised: Optimize for the shared display in the ops room, where it is actually read.
increments.reaction: Nobody opens this on a phone. It lives on the screen in the corner of the ops room all day.
